`44-69`: ** Trivial** · **Maintainability & Code Quality** · **Quick win** **Check that extraction precedes the backup** The test can pass if the backup moves before extraction. A failed extraction could then leave the installed app moved aside. Check the backup command directly.
Suggested fix

```diff require.Contains(t, script, extract) require.Less(t, strings.Index(script, extract), strings.Index(script, "quit_and_track_application '")) + backup := `sudo mv "$APPDIR/Foo.app" "$TMPDIR/Foo.app.bkp" || exit $?` + require.Contains(t, script, backup) + require.Less(t, strings.Index(script, extract), strings.Index(script, backup)) } ```
